install.heading: Software Update Preparation
items: The software version update data is first saved to an SD card or CFexpress Type A memory card . \t Note: “CFexpress Type A memory card” is referred to as “CFexpress card(s)” in this document.
The camera is then updated using the screen menu. \t Note: Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for details on how to use the menu.

install.heading: Checking the Current Software Version
items: Select Version .
Select Version Number in the Maintenance menu.

install.heading: Notes About Updating
items: When updating the software, always connect the supplied AC adaptor to the camera. If a battery pack is attached at the same time, the update will continue even if the AC adaptor is subsequently disconnected.
Remove any connected devices (such as USB devices, SDI/HDMI cables, microphones, and shoe mount accessories), and eject any media cards that are not necessary for the update.
When using an SD card, use an SDXC memory card.

Use an SDXC or CFexpress card that has been formatted in the memory card slot using the camera's formatting function. \t Note: Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for details about the formatting function and supported SDXC / CFexpress cards.

install.heading: Saving the Software Version Update Data to an SDXC Card or CFexpress Card
items: Connect the formatted SDXC or CFexpress card to a computer.
Download the software version update data from the download page, then save the data file to your computer.
Save the data file in the root directory of the SDXC or CFexpress card. Do not change the file name.

install.heading: Before you start
items: Do not perform any of the following actions while updating the system software. Doing so could cause the update to fail and the camera to stop working:\n\n\t
Turning the camera off
Refer to the camera's Operating Instructions for more information.

install.heading: How to update the system software version
items: Insert the SDXC or CFexpress card that contains the saved software version update data into slot B of the camera. \t Note: Only slot B will recognize the software version update data.
Select Version .
Select Version Up in the Maintenance menu. \t Note: The Version Up option cannot be selected if the software version update data cannot be found.
Select Execute . \t Note: After performing this step, a “Please use the AC Adaptor” message will appear.

Select Execute on the software version update confirmation screen. \t Note: After performing this step, a “Version Update VX.XX > VY.YY” message will appear. \t( X.XX : current version number; Y.YY : newest version number)
Select Execute on the software version update confirmation screen again.\n\t
When the software version update is successfully completed, the access indicator will stop flashing, and the unit will restart automatically.

Check that the software version has been updated (refer to the Checking the Current Software Version section of this document for details). \t Note: If the system software has not been updated to the latest version, check the version update procedure, and then perform the update procedure again from step 1 .
Set the camera power switch to OFF , disconnect and reconnect the power cord, and then set the power switch to ON .
Check the software version update procedure, then perform the update procedure again from step 1 .
If the issue persists and the update is not successful, there may be a problem with the camera. In this case, please contact a Sony service representative for further assistance.

changelog: Adds support for the new camera tracking data output function OpenTrackIO * for Virtual Production
Expands the camera tracking data ( free‑d ) functionality:\n\t
Adds support for the following camera position and orientation offsets:\n\t\t
Offset for the slide‑base scale position
Supports additional name setting characters for the following Web App features:\n\t
PTZ Trace
PTZ Auto‑Framing composition presets
Improves SRT connectivity
Improves operational stability of the camera
*Compliant with SMPTE RIS‑OSVP

The output values for camera position information (X/Y/Z axis offsets) and orientation information (pan/tilt/roll angles) are unified between OpenTrackIO and free‑d . For details, please refer to the Integration Manual for Tracking Data Output .
If the camera is updated while SETUP switch 4 is ON , the IP address will be forcibly fixed and the camera may not be able to connect after the update.
Access the camera from a web browser and update the firmware. For details, please refer to the ILME-FR7 Help Guide .
The camera software update must be performed with the lens removed and the pan/tilt lock unlocked.

install.heading: Step 1: Download the Update File
items: Connect your computer to the internet.
Click the Download button above.
After reading the disclaimer, click Download .\n\t
Save the file to the desktop of your computer (recommended).

install.heading: Step 2: Update the Software
items: Connect the camera and the computer with the saved update file to the same network, and then turn them on.
Display the Web App screen of the camera in a web browser on the computer.\n\t
Select Maintenance -> Information -> Camera , and then check the Model Name and Version Number in the web menu.

Select Maintenance -> Information -> Camera -> Version Up in the web menu, press the Choose File button, and select the update file ( Update_ILMEFR7V400.dat ) that you downloaded. \t \t Note: Do not perform the following actions until the update has been completed:\n\t
Disconnecting the network
Closing the Web App screen (web browser)
The following screen appears: \t \n\t
The update will fail if no update is required. Check the software version of the camera again.
The update file will start uploading. A progress bar will appear during this process. Wait until the uploading is complete before proceeding. \t
When the update file finishes uploading, the Web App screen will appear and the update will start. \t Notes: \n\t
The update process time will vary depending on your network environment.
The POWER lamp will blink yellow during the update process.
When the update process ends, the camera will reboot automatically. This will take a few minutes. Leave the camera turned on and wait until the POWER lamp lights up in green.

changelog: Allows high-quality audio recording (96 kHz, 32-bit float) when the XLR-A4 adapter (sold separately) is attached to the Multi Interface Shoe
Adds support for the Preset Focus function with lenses that do not have power zoom\n
Supports displaying the focal length down to one decimal place
Allows simultaneous Delete and Rating of images recorded on both memory card slot 1 and slot 2
Allows the display of folder names and file names during playback
Allows you to cancel the scheduled transfer of selected images during FTP* transfer *FTP = File Transfer Protocol
Adds support for the following Transfer & Tagging settings:\n
A setting to automatically schedule FTP transfer of protected still images and videos from FTP Upload Preset
A setting to automatically protect still images transferred via FTP from FTP Upload Preset
A setting for configuring the SFTP (Secure File Transfer Protocol) server\n
Supports the Write Digital Signature function for movies as part of Sony’s Camera Authenticity Solution\n
Services may not be available in some countries or regions. For more information, please visit the Authenticity Catalog Page .
Supports Scan and Tag , Photo Cropping , and Volume Photography Commands under the Volume Photography License\n
The license is scheduled to become available from late May 2026 onwards. Note: Services may not be available in some countries or regions.
